verdict.rationale: Latham's own Emerging Companies page says it advises both startups and 'the venture capital partners and other institutional partners that finance the entrepreneurial ecosystem.' It also cites 'hundreds of emerging company financings' a year and a convertible-note generator built on 'market standard terms,' which supports cross-side market-terms knowledge. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of investor-side representation, and explicit evidence of current market-terms insight such as published deal-terms surveys or data (it is only implied by deal volume).

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table

citations.quote: Latham guides startups and emerging companies of all sizes as well as the venture capital partners and other institutional partners that finance the entrepreneurial ecosystem.
we advise on hundreds of emerging company financings totaling billions of dollars every year.
we connect investors with innovators to fuel growth through a variety of financing structures
helps startups raise capital with customizable market standard terms
